dialog.judgeDescription: Turn this answer into a test case, replayed every time the dataset runs.
dialog.reviewDescription: Check what the dataset will hold. A run sends the input to the agent and grades its answer against the expected one.
dialog.draftingWithExpectedOutput: Drafting the test case and the answer to aim for…
dialog.draftFailedTitle: The test case could not be drafted
dialog.draftFailedDescription: The LLM did not answer. Try again, or go back and change your choices.

verdict.label: Is this the answer the agent should give?

good.title: Good answer
good.description: The answer becomes the reference the agent is graded against.

bad.title: Bad answer
bad.description: Say what is wrong, and an LLM drafts the answer to aim for.

good.label: What is good about this answer?
good.placeholder: What the agent got right and must keep doing
good.description: Optional. Kept with the test case, so whoever reads the dataset knows why this answer is the reference.

bad.label: What is wrong with this answer?
bad.placeholder: What the agent got wrong, left out, or should not have said
bad.description: An LLM turns it into the answer the agent should have given. Kept with the test case.

comment.fromReport: Taken from the user's report. Edit it if it misses the point.
comment.required: Say what is wrong with this answer.

dataset.label: Dataset
dataset.nameTooShort: A dataset name needs at least {{count}} characters.

inputHints.firstTurn: This answer replies to the first message, so that message holds the whole conversation.
inputHints.conversation_one: Written by an LLM from the earlier turn, so the question stands on its own when a run replays it.
inputHints.conversation_other: Written by an LLM from the {{count}} earlier turns, so the question stands on its own when a run replays it.
inputHints.lastMessage_one: The user's last message as sent. A run does not replay the earlier turn.
inputHints.lastMessage_other: The user's last message as sent. A run does not replay the {{count}} earlier turns.

expectedOutputHints.good: The agent's answer, kept as the reference each run is graded against.
expectedOutputHints.bad: Drafted by an LLM from what you said is wrong. Each run is graded against it.

errors.expectedOutputRequired: The expected answer cannot be empty.
errors.draftInput: The question could not be drafted. Try again, or write it yourself.
errors.anonymize: The input could not be anonymized. Try again.
errors.save: The test case could not be saved. Try again.
